name: Rooftop Bar, Irvine
line: Sixteen Stories Up, Warm And Clear
lede: Irvine’s first rooftop bar is windy, open to the skyline and cleared now and then for window washing. Freestanding Eclipse heaters move where they are needed, and white Tungsten Electric blends into the ceiling.
data: Rooftop bar on a hotel, 16 stories up
Eclipse Smart-Heat® Freestanding · Tungsten Smart-Heat® Electric
Eclipse Dimmer Controller · On/Off switches for Tungsten

Bromic-published photograph from the case study.

beats: Set atop a hotel in Irvine, the bar opens onto a patio with views to Saddleback Mountain, framed by external columns and alternating beams under a high ceiling in neutral tones.

The rooftop is windy and the skyline had to stay in view. Window-washing equipment hangs over the building’s side, so the patio is cleared from time to time and nothing could be mounted on the perimeter.

Bromic’s design service reviewed the plans and sent a heat plan with spec sheets. Eclipse Freestanding gives directional heat over each lounge and table group and can be unplugged and moved; white Tungsten Electric heaters are hardwired to On/Off switches for staff.
